summary: BI PRO AS (org. no. 925 758 752) is a private limited company (AS) based in Kongsberg, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2020-10-07. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 62.100 (Dataprogrammeringstjenester). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 4.4 m and net income was -NOK 206 944. CEO: Yngve Gunnar Marthinsen; board chair: Bjørn Aage Haugen.
